question: Woman of 40 weeks of gestation in labor with 6 cm of dilation. Presents fetal decelerative pattern in cardiotocographic record so it is decided to perform a fetal blood microtome to assess fetal well-being. Result pH 7.22. The correct behavior is:

options.opb: Prepatological value, repeat take in 15-20 minutes.
options.opc: Moderate acidosis, repeat take in 1-2 hours.
options.opd: Value in normal limits, leave natural evolution of childbirth.
options.ope: Repeat at the time, possible error in obtaining the shot.
